title: Feature roster
summary: A 25-30 s social film, 16:9 and 9:16 from one project: a hook in the product's own words, the product's agents or features as a roster that flies up into a tab bar, one 3 s beat per member with a push into the real screenshot and a colour ring on the proof, then the team gathers on the logo.

craft: hook in the product's own words within 1 s of the film
the same beat once per member, so the pattern is learned once
every scene starts on a beat (0.06 + 0.5k s)
screenshots never past 1.7 screen px per source px

style.ground: one dark ground; the screenshots are the only bright thing
style.type: one grotesque sans (600 headlines), mono labels
style.accent: each member's own colour on its dot, ring and tab only
style.motion: one slow push per screenshot; type holds once landed

tool.assets: tools/prep.py cuts avatars and a white logo out of the product's screenshots

reference.name: Our earlier 20.5 s AI-team film for an AI marketing product

result.example_product: Grok Bot (unofficial spec film, not affiliated with its makers)

from_product: 1-3 real screenshots that show every member's work
a small icon or avatar per member (cut from the screenshots)
the product's own copy: a two-line problem, a one-line promise, a tagline, one status line per member
generated: one 120 BPM music track, film length (prompt in project/tools/music.md)

fits: AI agents or assistants with named roles
products with 3-6 distinct features, modules or plans that each have a screen
feed posts and launch threads that need 16:9 and 9:16
avoid: products with no screens to show
one-feature products (use a single-feature film instead)
more than 6 members (the tab bar and the length stop working)
combines_with: launch/broll-wheel (as the product chapter of a longer launch)
